entries.title: Sacred Oath
entries.body:
# Sacred Oath

## Overview
To walk the path of a Religious Class is to enter into a sacred covenant with a higher power. Through solemn vows, unwavering faith, or absolute devotion, you pledge yourself to a patron whose ideals shall guide your actions and shape the divine gifts bestowed upon you.

This covenant is more than a promise—it is a living bond between mortal and deity. As your faith deepens, so too does your patron's willingness to grant divine blessings. Every miracle you perform, every trial you overcome, and every oath you uphold strengthens this sacred connection.

Although every Religious Class forms the same Divine Covenant, each serves their patron in different ways. A Paladin becomes the patron's champion upon the battlefield, a Cleric becomes their vessel of divine miracles, an Inquisitor becomes their righteous judge, while other Religious Classes express that devotion through their own unique calling.

## Rank 1
### Description

To walk the path of a Religious Class is to enter into a sacred covenant with a higher power. Through solemn vows, unwavering faith, or absolute devotion, you pledge yourself to a patron whose ideals shall guide your actions and shape the divine gifts bestowed upon you.

This covenant is more than a promise—it is a living bond between mortal and deity. As your faith deepens, so too does your patron's willingness to grant divine blessings. Every miracle you perform, every trial you overcome, and every oath you uphold strengthens this sacred connection.

Although every Religious Class forms the same Divine Covenant, each serves their patron in different ways. A Paladin becomes the patron's champion upon the battlefield, a Cleric becomes their vessel of divine miracles, an Inquisitor becomes their righteous judge, while other Religious Classes express that devotion through their own unique calling.

### Effects

- Choose a patron to form your **Divine Covenant** with.
- Your chosen patron becomes permanent unless changed through a major story event, divine intervention, or GM approval.
- Gain your patron's **Rank I Class Boon**.
- The Class Boon granted depends on both your **chosen patron** and your **Religious Class**.
- Unlock your patron's **Religious Pages**, including:
  - Divine Resonance
  - Divine Opposition
  - Divine Authority
  - Class Boons
  - Patron Features
- All talents that reference your patron now use the information found within your chosen patron's Religious Pages.
- Future ranks of **Sacred Oath** grant additional Class Boons from your chosen patron.

### Lore

Every faith teaches that divine power cannot simply be taken—it must be entrusted. Through the Sacred Oath, a deity acknowledges a mortal's devotion and accepts them into their service, establishing a covenant that may last a lifetime. From that moment onward, the faithful no longer walk alone, for every miracle they perform is shaped by the ideals of the patron they have chosen to serve.

Across Asteria, countless covenants exist between gods and mortals. Some are forged through unwavering honour, others through sacrifice, wisdom, justice, fate, life, death, or even darker ideals. Though the paths differ, all who swear a Sacred Oath accept the same responsibility—to uphold their patron's divine will within the mortal realm.

> *"A prayer is spoken with the lips. An oath is spoken with the soul. The gods remember the difference."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your bond with your patron grows stronger as your actions continue to honour the covenant you have sworn. Through faithful service, steadfast devotion, and unwavering commitment to your sacred calling, your patron places greater trust in your abilities, rewarding your dedication with a deeper blessing.

The Divine Covenant is a living relationship that strengthens over time. Every miracle performed, every hardship endured, and every trial overcome reaffirms your place within your patron's service. As your faith matures, so too do the gifts bestowed upon you.

Though every Religious Class follows the same covenant, no two paths are identical. A patron grants different blessings to their Paladins, Clerics, Priests, Inquisitors, Oracles, and other faithful, ensuring each servant fulfils their own divine purpose within the world.

### Effects

- Your **Divine Covenant** deepens with your chosen patron.
- Gain your patron's **Rank II Class Boon**.
- The Class Boon granted depends on both your **chosen patron** and your **Religious Class**.
- Unlock any additional **Divine Authority**, **Class Features**, or **Patron Features** granted by your patron at Rank II.
- All talents that reference your patron continue to use the information contained within your chosen patron's Religious Pages.
- Your Sacred Oath remains bound to your chosen patron unless changed through a major story event, divine intervention, or GM approval.

### Lore

The greatest servants of the gods understand that faith is not measured by a single promise, but by the countless choices made after that promise is sworn. Each act of loyalty strengthens the covenant, allowing the patron to reveal greater aspects of their divine purpose to those who have proven worthy.

Ancient scriptures speak of champions whose devotion became so profound that their patrons entrusted them with miracles reserved for only the most faithful. Such blessings are never given lightly, for every gift carries the expectation that it will be used in accordance with the patron's divine will.

> *"The oath is not completed when it is spoken. It is renewed every day through the choices of the faithful."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

The covenant between you and your patron has become an unshakable bond. Your faith is no longer measured solely by your words or deeds, but by the trust your patron has placed within you. Through countless trials, unwavering devotion, and faithful service, you have proven yourself worthy of receiving greater divine gifts.

As your Divine Covenant strengthens, your patron entrusts you with blessings reserved for only their most devoted servants. These sacred boons are not simply rewards—they are symbols of responsibility, reflecting your growing role within your patron's divine purpose.

Though every Religious Class walks beneath the same Divine Covenant, each fulfils a different calling. Whether champion, healer, judge, prophet, or guardian, every faithful servant receives blessings uniquely suited to their sacred role.

### Effects

- Your **Divine Covenant** strengthens with your chosen patron.
- Gain your patron's **Rank III Class Boon**.
- The Class Boon granted depends on both your **chosen patron** and your **Religious Class**.
- Unlock any additional **Divine Authority**, **Class Features**, or **Patron Features** granted by your patron at Rank III.
- All talents that reference your patron continue to use the information contained within your chosen patron's Religious Pages.
- Your Sacred Oath remains bound to your chosen patron unless changed through a major story event, divine intervention, or GM approval.

### Lore

Only the truly devoted ever reach this stage of the Divine Covenant. By now, your patron no longer sees you as merely another follower, but as a trusted servant whose actions carry their ideals into the mortal world. Every miracle performed and every oath upheld strengthens the bond between deity and disciple.

Throughout Asteria's history, many legendary heroes earned their place in history not through unmatched strength, but through unwavering devotion to their patron's will. Their names became synonymous with the virtues they embodied, inspiring generations of faithful who sought to walk the same sacred path.

> *"A covenant is strengthened not through promises, but through every faithful step taken after the promise is made."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your Divine Covenant has matured into an extraordinary bond, one recognised not only by your patron but by the celestial, infernal, primal, or cosmic powers that serve beneath them. Your unwavering faith has carried you through countless trials, proving your devotion beyond question and earning the trust required to wield greater fragments of your patron's divine authority.

Few faithful ever reach this stage of their covenant. Those who do become living representatives of their patron's ideals, entrusted to act with wisdom, courage, and conviction wherever their journey leads. Every decision you make reflects upon the deity you serve, and every miracle performed strengthens the connection between the mortal and the divine.

Although every Religious Class follows the same Divine Covenant, each fulfils a different purpose within their patron's design. The blessings granted to a Paladin differ greatly from those bestowed upon a Cleric, Priest, Inquisitor, Oracle, or other servant, ensuring every champion is equipped to fulfil the role their patron has chosen for them.

### Effects

- Your **Divine Covenant** deepens further with your chosen patron.
- Gain your patron's **Rank IV Class Boon**.
- The Class Boon granted depends on both your **chosen patron** and your **Religious Class**.
- Unlock any additional **Divine Authority**, **Class Features**, or **Patron Features** granted by your patron at Rank IV.
- All talents that reference your patron continue to use the information contained within your chosen patron's Religious Pages.
- Your Sacred Oath remains bound to your chosen patron unless changed through a major story event, divine intervention, or GM approval.

### Lore

The fourth stage of the Divine Covenant is spoken of with great reverence throughout Asteria. It marks the point where a follower ceases to be viewed as merely faithful and instead becomes a true champion of their patron's ideals. Their actions inspire fellow believers, while their presence alone often serves as a reminder that the gods still guide the mortal world.

Ancient records tell of covenant bearers who turned the tide of wars, restored dying kingdoms, or stood alone against impossible darkness—not through unmatched strength, but because their patron's trust had become absolute. Such individuals are remembered for generations as examples of what unwavering devotion can achieve.

> *"When a god places their trust in a mortal, the weight of that trust becomes both their greatest blessing and their greatest responsibility."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your Divine Covenant has reached its ultimate expression. Through unwavering faith, selfless service, and absolute devotion, you have become one of your patron's most trusted champions upon the mortal plane. The bond between your soul and your deity has become so profound that your actions are no longer seen as those of a mere follower, but as an extension of your patron's divine will.

The blessings granted through this covenant represent far more than power. They are a sacred responsibility entrusted only to those who have proven themselves worthy through countless trials and steadfast conviction. Every miracle you perform, every judgement you deliver, and every life you touch reflects directly upon the deity you serve.

Although every Religious Class reaches this pinnacle through the same Divine Covenant, each fulfils a unique role within their patron's design. Whether serving as a righteous champion, compassionate healer, fearless inquisitor, devoted priest, enlightened oracle, or another sacred calling, all stand among the greatest representatives of their chosen patron.

### Effects

- Your **Divine Covenant** reaches its final stage.
- Gain your patron's **Rank V Class Boon**.
- The Class Boon granted depends on both your **chosen patron** and your **Religious Class**.
- Unlock your patron's complete **Divine Authority**, **Class Features**, and any remaining **Patron Features** granted at Rank V.
- All talents that reference your patron continue to use the information contained within your chosen patron's Religious Pages.
- Your Sacred Oath is considered complete, marking you as one of your patron's chosen champions.
- Your Sacred Oath remains bound to your chosen patron unless altered through an extraordinary story event or direct divine intervention, at the GM's discretion.

### Lore

Only the rarest individuals ever complete the Divine Covenant. Their names are remembered within temples, recorded in sacred texts, and spoken with reverence by generations of the faithful. They are not worshipped as gods, but honoured as the greatest examples of mortal devotion, proving that absolute faith can bridge the divide between the mortal and the divine.

Legends tell that when such champions walk the world, the presence of their patron can almost be felt by those around them. Whether bringing hope, judgement, wisdom, balance, or even necessary destruction, they become living symbols of the ideals they have sworn to uphold. Though they remain mortal, their legacy often endures long after their final breath.

> *"A covenant does not end when its final blessing is granted. It lives on through every soul inspired by the one who was faithful enough to receive it."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Aura of Valor
entries.body:
# Aura of Valor

## Overview
The courage of a true Paladin is infectious. Through unwavering faith and steadfast resolve, your presence inspires those around you to stand firm against impossible odds. Allies fighting beside you find renewed confidence in their own abilities, emboldened by the certainty that they do not stand alone.

Unlike miraculous blessings that must be consciously invoked, the Aura of Valor is a constant expression of your devotion. Whether defending a village, charging into battle, or standing as the last line between darkness and the innocent, your conviction strengthens the hearts of those who choose to fight at your side.

Though every patron manifests this aura differently, its purpose remains the same—to inspire greatness in those who share your cause. Radiant light, spectral ravens, blooming life, celestial flame, infernal embers, or countless other divine manifestations remind friend and foe alike that true courage can change the course of any battle.

## Rank 1
### Description

The courage of a true Paladin is infectious. Through unwavering faith and steadfast resolve, your presence inspires those around you to stand firm against impossible odds. Allies fighting beside you find renewed confidence in their own abilities, emboldened by the certainty that they do not stand alone.

Unlike miraculous blessings that must be consciously invoked, the Aura of Valor is a constant expression of your devotion. Whether defending a village, charging into battle, or standing as the last line between darkness and the innocent, your conviction strengthens the hearts of those who choose to fight at your side.

Though every patron manifests this aura differently, its purpose remains the same—to inspire greatness in those who share your cause. Radiant light, spectral ravens, blooming life, celestial flame, infernal embers, or countless other divine manifestations remind friend and foe alike that true courage can change the course of any battle.

### Effects

- While you are **conscious**, project a **5 metre Aura of Valor**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 on Attack Rolls**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 damage** with melee and ranged weapon attacks.
- A creature only benefits from one **Aura of Valor** at a time.
- The visual appearance of the aura is determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Military commanders throughout Asteria have long sought the companionship of Paladins, not merely for their martial prowess, but for the remarkable effect their presence has upon those around them. Warriors who would normally falter often find themselves standing resolute, driven onward by the unwavering conviction radiating from the Paladin's soul.

Many songs tell of hopeless battles won because a single champion refused to yield. Those who survived rarely speak of overwhelming strength or divine miracles. Instead, they remember the feeling that, so long as the Paladin still stood, victory remained possible.

> *"Valor is not the absence of fear. It is the courage to inspire others even while fear stands beside you."*  
> **— Sir Aldren, First Shield of the Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your unwavering courage continues to inspire those who fight beside you. Warriors within your presence find themselves acting with greater confidence, striking with renewed determination and refusing to surrender even against overwhelming odds. Your patron's influence strengthens every ally who chooses to stand alongside you, forging a united front that is far greater than the sum of its parts.

As your mastery grows, the Aura of Valor becomes more than simple inspiration—it becomes a symbol of unity. Allies instinctively fight with greater discipline, trusting in one another and drawing strength from your steadfast leadership. Whether charging into battle or holding the line against impossible enemies, your presence reminds every companion that courage shared is courage multiplied.

### Effects

- While you are **conscious**, project a **7 metre Aura of Valor**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 on Attack Rolls**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+4 damage** with melee and ranged weapon attacks.
- The first melee weapon attack an ally makes each round while within the aura deals an additional **+1 Patron Damage**.
- A creature only benefits from one **Aura of Valor** at a time.
- The visual appearance and Patron Damage type are determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Paladins who reach this level of mastery become natural rallying points upon the battlefield. Soldiers often recount that fear fades when they stand beside such champions, replaced instead by an overwhelming desire to protect those fighting alongside them. Entire companies have been known to hold impossible defensive lines simply because a Paladin's banner still flew above the battlefield.

Temples teach that true valor is not measured by the strength of a single warrior, but by the courage they awaken in others. Through unwavering faith, a Paladin becomes the heart of every formation, binding companions together through shared conviction and divine purpose.

> *"One brave soul may begin the charge, but true valor is measured by how many find the courage to follow."*  
> **— Sir Aldren, First Shield of the Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your presence has become a symbol of unwavering heroism, inspiring extraordinary acts of courage from those who fight beside you. Allies no longer draw strength solely from your conviction—they begin to fight with greater precision, coordination, and confidence, trusting completely in the leadership of your patron's chosen champion.

Every advance becomes more decisive, every strike more deliberate, and every victory more achievable. Warriors who once hesitated now press forward with renewed determination, emboldened by the knowledge that they stand beneath the watchful blessing of your patron. Whether leading a handful of companions or an entire army, your Aura of Valor transforms ordinary soldiers into steadfast heroes.

Though every patron expresses this blessing differently, all share the same purpose: to inspire courage through action and reward those willing to stand together against overwhelming darkness.

### Effects

- While you are **conscious**, project a **10 metre Aura of Valor**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+4 on Attack Rolls**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+4 damage** with melee and ranged weapon attacks.
- The first successful weapon attack each round made by an ally within the aura deals an additional **1d4 Patron Damage**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 on Critical Confirmation Rolls** (or **+2 to confirm Critical Hits**, if your system uses confirmation rolls).
- A creature may only benefit from one **Aura of Valor** at a time.
- The appearance of the aura and the Patron Damage type are determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

As legends spread across Asteria, veteran soldiers speak not only of the Paladin's strength, but of the impossible feats accomplished by those who fought beside them. Entire companies have stood firm against impossible odds, inspired by the unwavering conviction radiating from a single champion whose faith never faltered.

Many commanders believe that true valor is contagious. While courage may begin within one heart, it is through shared conviction that armies accomplish the impossible. Those blessed by a master's Aura of Valor often leave the battlefield believing they achieved far more than they ever thought themselves capable of.

> *"A hero may win a duel. A true champion gives others the courage to win a war."*  
> **— Sir Aldren, First Shield of the Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your unwavering courage has become legendary, inspiring extraordinary acts of heroism from all who fight beside you. Your patron's blessing radiates far beyond your own strength, urging companions to strike boldly, defend one another, and press the attack with unwavering confidence. Those who stand within your presence feel as though victory is always within reach, no matter how overwhelming the enemy.

Veteran warriors often describe this aura as impossible to ignore. Doubt fades, hesitation disappears, and every ally instinctively fights with greater purpose. Your patron's divine will flows through your leadership, transforming a band of adventurers into a unified force capable of overcoming challenges that would otherwise seem impossible.

To enemies, your presence is equally terrifying. Every successful strike delivered by your companions serves as another reminder that they are not facing a lone Paladin, but the united conviction of an entire company blessed by the divine.

### Effects

- While you are **conscious**, project a **12 metre Aura of Valor**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 on Attack Rolls**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+6 damage** with melee and ranged weapon attacks.
- The first successful weapon attack each round made by an ally within the aura deals an additional **1d6 Patron Damage**.
- Once per round, when an ally within the aura scores a **Critical Hit**, they immediately gain **+2 AC** until the start of their next turn.
- A creature may only benefit from one **Aura of Valor** at a time.
- The appearance of the aura and the **Patron Damage** type are determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

The greatest generals throughout Asteria have long sought the companionship of Paladins whose Aura of Valor could inspire entire armies to achieve what should have been impossible. Tales tell of defenders who held broken walls, exhausted soldiers who found renewed strength, and desperate charges that became glorious victories simply because one faithful champion refused to yield.

Such Paladins become living banners upon the battlefield. Wherever they stand, courage flourishes, hope endures, and even the darkest conflicts become opportunities for heroes to rise above fear and embrace the ideals their patron represents.

> *"Valor is not measured by the strength of one champion, but by the greatness they awaken in every soul willing to stand beside them."*  
> **— Sir Aldren, First Shield of the Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your courage has become an unshakable beacon of hope, inspiring extraordinary acts of heroism in all who stand beside you. The battlefield itself seems to rally around your presence as your patron's divine blessing flows through every ally who shares your cause. Fear is replaced by determination, hesitation gives way to decisive action, and even the darkest battles become opportunities to prove the strength of unwavering conviction.

Veteran Paladins who reach this level are remembered not only for their own deeds, but for the heroes they inspire. Entire companies fight harder beneath their banner, companions discover reserves of strength they never knew they possessed, and impossible victories become legendary tales passed down through generations. Wherever your Aura of Valor shines, your patron's ideals become a living force that unites those willing to stand together.

Though every patron manifests this blessing differently, each reminds friend and foe alike that true valor is never the work of one champion alone—it is the courage shared by all who fight with unwavering faith.

### Effects

- While you are **conscious**, project a **15 metre Aura of Valor**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 on Attack Rolls**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+8 damage** with melee and ranged weapon attacks.
- The first successful weapon attack each round made by an ally within the aura deals an additional **1d8 Patron Damage**.
- Once per round, when an ally within the aura scores a **Critical Hit**, they immediately gain **+2 AC** until the start of their next turn.
- Once per round, an ally within the aura may **reroll one missed weapon attack**. The second result must be used.
- A creature may only benefit from one **Aura of Valor** at a time.
- The appearance of the aura and the **Patron Damage** type are determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

The greatest Paladins in history are remembered not because they stood alone against impossible odds, but because they inspired others to do the same. Their courage became contagious, their conviction unwavering, and their presence transformed ordinary soldiers into legendary heroes whose names would be remembered for centuries.

The oldest temples teach that this is the highest expression of valor—not personal glory, but the ability to awaken greatness within others. Those blessed with such an aura become living symbols of their patron's ideals, carrying hope wherever they travel and reminding all who witness them that true courage is strongest when it is shared.

> *"A single hero may save a life. A true champion teaches others they were heroes all along."*  
> **— Sir Aldren, First Shield of the Covenant**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Bastion of Faith
entries.body:
# Bastion of Faith

## Overview
Your faith becomes an unshakable foundation, allowing you to assume a defensive stance that transforms you into a steadfast protector. Rather than seeking swift victory, you prepare yourself to endure the enemy's assault, trusting your patron to strengthen your resolve against every blow.

While Bastion of Faith is active, your movements become deliberate and unwavering. Every step is taken with purpose, every stance rooted in conviction. Though enemies may attempt to force you aside, your devotion anchors both body and spirit, making you increasingly difficult to displace.

To a seasoned Paladin, the greatest victory is not measured by the enemies they defeat, but by the allies who remain standing because they refused to yield.

## Rank 1
### Description

Your faith becomes an unshakable foundation, allowing you to assume a defensive stance that transforms you into a steadfast protector. Rather than seeking swift victory, you prepare yourself to endure the enemy's assault, trusting your patron to strengthen your resolve against every blow.

While Bastion of Faith is active, your movements become deliberate and unwavering. Every step is taken with purpose, every stance rooted in conviction. Though enemies may attempt to force you aside, your devotion anchors both body and spirit, making you increasingly difficult to displace.

To a seasoned Paladin, the greatest victory is not measured by the enemies they defeat, but by the allies who remain standing because they refused to yield.

### Effects

- Spend **25 MP** and **10 SP** to enter **Bastion of Faith**.
- Bastion of Faith lasts for **5 Rounds**.
- Gain **+2 AC** while Bastion of Faith is active.
- Gain **+2 on all checks or Saving Throws made to resist forced movement**, being shoved, knocked back, pulled, grappled, or otherwise repositioned against your will.
- The visual manifestation of Bastion of Faith is determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional defensive blessings granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Among every holy order, the Bastion is admired not for overwhelming strength, but for unwavering resolve. These champions willingly stand where others would retreat, trusting that their patron will grant them the courage to endure whatever darkness lies ahead.

The oldest fortresses of Asteria are said to have been inspired by such warriors. Their walls were built to imitate the same unyielding conviction displayed by the first Paladins who stood firm against impossible odds, refusing to surrender even when the world itself seemed determined to move them.

> *"The mountain does not resist the storm through strength alone. It stands because it refuses to move."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your conviction grows stronger with every battle fought in your patron's name. While others rely upon strength alone, you have learned that true resilience comes from unwavering faith and the willingness to place yourself between danger and those who cannot protect themselves.

While Bastion of Faith is active, your presence becomes a rallying point for allies. Enemies find it increasingly difficult to force you from your position, while your steadfast resolve allows you to intervene whenever your companions are threatened. Every successful defence strengthens your reputation as an unyielding guardian whose faith cannot be shaken.

To your allies, you become a reassuring presence upon the battlefield. To your enemies, you become an obstacle that refuses to yield.

### Effects

- Spend **30 MP** and **10 SP** to enter **Bastion of Faith**.
- Bastion of Faith lasts for **5 Rounds**.
- Gain **+3 AC** while Bastion of Faith is active.
- Gain **+4 on all checks or Saving Throws made to resist forced movement**, being shoved, knocked back, pulled, grappled, or otherwise repositioned against your will.
- **Once per round**, when a creature within your melee reach targets an allied creature with a melee attack, you may use your **Reaction** to impose **Disadvantage** on that attack.
- The visual manifestation of Bastion of Faith is determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional defensive blessings granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Every great fortress begins with a single stone that refuses to break. Likewise, every legendary guardian begins with a single vow—to stand firm regardless of the danger before them. Through years of faithful service, a Paladin learns that the strongest defence is often their own willingness to become the shield others need.

Many temples teach that a Bastion is not defined by the armour they wear, but by the lives they protect. Those who master this sacred stance become symbols of hope, standing as unwavering guardians while chaos crashes harmlessly against their unbreakable resolve.

> *"Walls are built from stone. A true bastion is built from conviction."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your devotion has become an unbreakable foundation upon which others may stand. While Bastion of Faith is active, every blow endured and every attack turned aside strengthens your resolve, allowing your patron's blessing to reinforce both body and spirit. Your enemies soon realise that attempting to break your defence only serves to strengthen your determination.

Veteran Paladins understand that true endurance is not measured by how little damage they suffer, but by their ability to continue standing when others would have fallen. Through absolute conviction, your patron rewards your steadfast defence with renewed strength, enabling you to hold the line against even the fiercest assault.

As your reputation spreads, allies instinctively rally behind your unwavering presence, while enemies begin to recognise the futility of attempting to force aside a guardian whose faith has become stronger than steel.

### Effects

- Spend **35 MP** and **15 SP** to enter **Bastion of Faith**.
- Bastion of Faith lasts for **6 Rounds**.
- Gain **+4 AC** while Bastion of Faith is active.
- Gain **+6 on all checks or Saving Throws made to resist forced movement**, being shoved, knocked back, pulled, grappled, or otherwise repositioned against your will.
- **Once per round**, when a creature within your melee reach targets an allied creature with a melee attack, you may use your **Reaction** to impose **Disadvantage** on that attack.
- **Once per round**, when you successfully avoid a melee attack, or reduce its damage through a successful defensive action, gain **Temporary HP equal to your Charisma Modifier + Half your Character Level**.
- Temporary HP gained through Bastion of Faith does not stack. If you gain Temporary HP again, keep the higher value.
- The visual manifestation of Bastion of Faith is determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional defensive blessings granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

The greatest bastions are remembered not because they never fell, but because they endured long enough for hope to triumph. Every strike deflected, every ally protected, and every step held against overwhelming odds becomes another testament to the strength granted through unwavering faith.

The oldest military orders teach that a Bastion's greatest weapon is not their sword, but their refusal to yield. Legends tell of champions who stood alone at broken gates, holding back entire armies until reinforcements arrived, their conviction becoming an inspiration that outlived them by centuries.

> *"Steel may guard the body, but conviction guards the soul. When both stand together, no force can break them."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your devotion has become an immovable bulwark against the darkness. No longer content to simply endure your enemies' assaults, you willingly place yourself between danger and those under your protection, trusting completely in your patron to grant you the strength to bear burdens that would overwhelm lesser warriors.

Within Bastion of Faith, your resolve inspires absolute confidence in your allies. They know that while you continue to stand, they will never face the enemy alone. Every strike intercepted and every wound endured serves as another testament to the sacred covenant you uphold, proving that true faith is measured not by the lives you take, but by the lives you save.

Among the greatest holy orders, this mastery is regarded as the defining quality of a true guardian. To become a Bastion is to accept that your own safety is secondary to the protection of those who fight beside you.

### Effects

- Spend **40 MP** and **15 SP** to enter **Bastion of Faith**.
- Bastion of Faith lasts for **6 Rounds**.
- Gain **+5 AC** while Bastion of Faith is active.
- Gain **+8 on all checks or Saving Throws made to resist forced movement**, being shoved, knocked back, pulled, grappled, or otherwise repositioned against your will.
- **Once per round**, when an allied creature within **3 metres** is hit by a melee or ranged weapon attack, you may use your **Reaction** to become the new target of that attack before damage is rolled.
- Apply your own **AC, resistances, and defensive effects** against the intercepted attack.
- **Once per round**, when you successfully avoid a melee attack or reduce its damage through a successful defensive action, gain **Temporary HP equal to your Charisma Modifier + Half your Character Level**.
- Temporary HP gained through Bastion of Faith does not stack. If you gain Temporary HP again, keep the higher value.
- The visual manifestation of Bastion of Faith is determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional defensive blessings granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

The legends of Asteria remember many great warriors, yet few are honoured as highly as those who willingly stood between danger and the innocent. Such champions became living shields, placing themselves in harm's way without hesitation, knowing their patron's blessing would grant them the resolve to endure.

Temples teach that this is the highest calling of a guardian. Strength is not measured by how many enemies fall before you, but by how many lives continue because you chose to stand where others could not.

> *"A true shield is never carried for its own protection. It is raised for the sake of another."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your faith has become an unbreakable fortress, allowing you to stand as your patron's ultimate guardian upon the battlefield. Every trial endured, every ally protected, and every oath upheld has forged a spirit that refuses to yield. When Bastion of Faith is invoked, you become the living embodiment of steadfast devotion, a champion whose resolve cannot be shaken by mortal strength alone.

Enemies soon discover that moving you is as futile as attempting to push back the mountains themselves. Your patron's blessing anchors your body and soul, while your unwavering determination allows you to intercept even the deadliest blows intended for those under your protection. So long as you continue to stand, your allies know there is still hope.

Among every holy order, reaching this mastery is regarded as the highest expression of selfless courage. To become a Bastion is to willingly bear the burden of others, trusting that your patron will grant you the strength to endure until the battle is won.

### Effects

- Spend **50 MP** and **20 SP** to enter **Bastion of Faith**.
- Bastion of Faith lasts for **8 Rounds**.
- Gain **+6 AC** while Bastion of Faith is active.
- Gain **Advantage** on all checks and Saving Throws made to resist being shoved, knocked back, pulled, grappled, knocked prone, or otherwise forcibly moved.
- Creatures attempting to forcibly move you have **Disadvantage** on any opposed rolls or ability checks made to do so, where applicable.
- **Once per round**, when an allied creature within **5 metres** is hit by a melee or ranged weapon attack, you may use your **Reaction** to become the new target of that attack before damage is rolled.
- Apply your own **AC, resistances, armour, and defensive effects** against the intercepted attack.
- **Once per round**, when you successfully avoid an attack or reduce its damage through a successful defensive action, gain **Temporary HP equal to your Character Level + your Charisma Modifier**.
- Temporary HP gained through Bastion of Faith does not stack. If gained again, keep the higher value.
- The visual manifestation of Bastion of Faith is determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional defensive blessings granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Only the greatest champions of the divine ever attain the title of Bastion. Their unwavering conviction becomes legendary, their names forever remembered alongside the countless lives they saved. To friend and foe alike, they are not simply warriors—they are the immovable foundation upon which hope itself is built.

Many of Asteria's oldest fortresses bear statues of such guardians, depicting them standing resolute against impossible odds. Though kingdoms have risen and fallen around these monuments, they remain enduring symbols of a timeless truth: the strongest shield is not forged from steel, but from a soul that refuses to surrender.

> *"When the storm comes, become the mountain. When darkness advances, become the wall. Let your faith be the fortress that others call home."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**

None

entries.body:
# Unyielding Conviction

## Overview
There are moments when even the greatest champions falter. A failed leap, a crippling curse, or a test of will can mean the difference between salvation and ruin. Yet a Paladin does not surrender to failure so easily. Through unwavering faith, you may call upon your patron to grant you one final opportunity to overcome the impossible.

When invoking Unyielding Conviction, you place your trust entirely in your patron. Your own skill gives way to divine guidance as fate itself is rewritten for a single fleeting moment. This blessing is never granted lightly, demanding both physical endurance and divine energy to invoke.

Those who witness this miracle often describe it as impossible to explain. To the faithful, however, the answer is simple—where conviction is absolute, even fate may bend.

## Rank 1
### Description

There are moments when even the greatest champions falter. A failed leap, a crippling curse, or a test of will can mean the difference between salvation and ruin. Yet a Paladin does not surrender to failure so easily. Through unwavering faith, you may call upon your patron to grant you one final opportunity to overcome the impossible.

When invoking Unyielding Conviction, you place your trust entirely in your patron. Your own skill gives way to divine guidance as fate itself is rewritten for a single fleeting moment. This blessing is never granted lightly, demanding both physical endurance and divine energy to invoke.

Those who witness this miracle often describe it as impossible to explain. To the faithful, however, the answer is simple—where conviction is absolute, even fate may bend.

### Effects

- **Once per Long Rest**, after failing a **Saving Throw** or **Skill Check**, you may invoke **Unyielding Conviction**.
- Spend **10 MP** and **10 SP** to activate this ability.
- Repeat the failed roll using your **Luck Modifier** in place of the modifier normally applied to the roll.
- If the original action required additional **MP, SP, HP, consumables, charges, ammunition, or other resources**, those costs must also be paid again before the second attempt is made.
- If the failed roll involved **multiple dice** (such as **Advantage** or **Disadvantage**), you may reroll **only one** of those dice. The rerolled die replaces its original result before determining the final outcome.
- The repeated attempt is treated as a completely new roll.
- You must accept the result of the second attempt, even if it is lower than the original.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

The scriptures of every faith tell stories of champions who faced certain failure, only to find the strength to rise once more. Some speak of an unseen hand guiding them, while others recall hearing nothing more than a quiet whisper urging them to stand again. Whatever form the miracle takes, all agree that it is not earned through strength alone, but through absolute trust in one's patron.

Among the faithful, Unyielding Conviction is regarded as one of the purest demonstrations of divine favour. A patron does not guarantee success, nor do they erase failure. Instead, they grant their champion one final opportunity to prove that their faith is worthy of the miracle they have received.

> *"The gods do not promise victory. They promise that those who refuse to yield will never stand alone."*  
> **— High Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your faith has deepened beyond simple perseverance. When adversity threatens to overwhelm you, your patron's guidance becomes clearer, allowing destiny itself to shift ever so slightly in your favour. Though failure may still come, your conviction grants you another opportunity to prove your worth through unwavering devotion.

Each time you invoke Unyielding Conviction, you reaffirm the sacred bond between yourself and your patron. It is not a miracle born from desperation, but a conscious act of trust, placing your fate into divine hands and accepting whatever outcome follows.

Those who witness such moments often believe they have seen fate rewritten. The faithful know the truth—it is simply the reward of absolute conviction.

### Effects

- **Once per Long Rest**, after failing a **Saving Throw** or **Skill Check**, you may invoke **Unyielding Conviction**.
- Spend **15 MP** and **15 SP** to activate this ability.
- Repeat the failed roll using your **Luck Modifier** in place of the attribute modifier normally applied to the roll.
- If the original action required additional **MP, SP, HP, consumables, charges, ammunition, or other resources**, those costs must also be paid again before the second attempt is made.
- If the failed roll involved **multiple dice** (such as **Advantage** or **Disadvantage**), you may reroll **only one** of those dice. The rerolled die replaces its original result before determining the final outcome.
- Gain **+2** to the repeated roll.
- The repeated attempt is treated as a completely new roll.
- You must accept the result of the second attempt, even if it is lower than the original.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

The greatest Paladins teach that faith is strongest when tested. Every trial overcome strengthens the covenant between champion and patron, until even fate itself seems willing to offer one final opportunity. Such miracles are never guaranteed, nor are they given freely. They are gifts entrusted only to those who have demonstrated unwavering devotion through both triumph and hardship.

Across the temples of Asteria, stories are told of champions who survived impossible ordeals because they refused to surrender when all hope seemed lost. Whether facing ancient dragons, enduring terrible curses, or standing against overwhelming armies, they prevailed not through strength alone, but because their conviction never wavered.

> *"The faithful do not ask the gods to change destiny. They ask only for the strength to meet it one final time."*  
> **— High Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your faith has become an unwavering beacon, allowing your patron's guidance to shine through even in moments of absolute despair. When others would accept failure, you refuse to yield, trusting completely in the divine covenant that binds your soul to a higher purpose. Every miracle granted through Unyielding Conviction is a testament to the unbreakable trust between champion and patron.

Though fate may appear fixed, your conviction allows you to challenge it one final time. This blessing is never given lightly, demanding both physical endurance and divine power before your patron answers your plea. Those who witness such moments often believe destiny itself has been rewritten.

### Effects

- **Once per Long Rest**, after failing a **Saving Throw** or **Skill Check**, you may invoke **Unyielding Conviction**.
- Spend **20 MP** and **20 SP** to activate this ability.
- Repeat the failed roll using your **Luck Modifier** in place of the attribute modifier normally applied to the roll.
- Gain a **+4 bonus** to the repeated roll.
- If the original action required additional **MP, SP, HP, consumables, charges, ammunition, or other resources**, those costs must also be paid again before the second attempt is made.
- If the failed roll involved **multiple dice** (such as **Advantage** or **Disadvantage**), you may reroll **only one** of those dice. The rerolled die replaces its original result before determining the final outcome.
- The repeated attempt is treated as a completely new roll.
- You must accept the result of the second attempt, even if it is lower than the original.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Many believe miracles are extraordinary events granted only in the darkest hours. The faithful know differently. Miracles are not rewards for perfection—they are granted to those who continue standing when every reason to surrender has already passed. Such conviction cannot be forged overnight, but only through years of unwavering devotion.

The oldest scriptures tell of champions who survived impossible trials through nothing more than faith and determination. Whether escaping ancient curses, resisting overwhelming magic, or completing sacred rituals against impossible odds, they endured because their patron judged their purpose unfinished.

> *"Conviction is not the certainty that you will succeed. It is the certainty that you must try once more."*  
> **— High Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your faith has reached a level where even overwhelming adversity struggles to extinguish your resolve. When your body weakens or your spirit is tested, your patron grants you the strength to endure, allowing your conviction to overcome obstacles that would break lesser champions. Every miracle becomes a reminder that true faith is measured not by perfection, but by the refusal to surrender.

Invoking Unyielding Conviction is more than seeking another chance—it is a declaration that your purpose remains unfinished. Your patron answers by guiding your hand, steadying your spirit, and granting you one final opportunity to fulfil the task before you.

Those fortunate enough to witness such miracles often speak of an overwhelming sense of hope, as though destiny itself paused to acknowledge the strength of unwavering conviction.

### Effects

- **Once per Long Rest**, after failing a **Saving Throw** or **Skill Check**, you may invoke **Unyielding Conviction**.
- Spend **25 MP** and **25 SP** to activate this ability.
- Repeat the failed roll using your **Luck Modifier** in place of the attribute modifier normally applied to the roll.
- Gain a **+6 bonus** to the repeated roll.
- If the original action required additional **MP, SP, HP, consumables, charges, ammunition, or other resources**, those costs must also be paid again before the second attempt is made.
- If the failed roll involved **multiple dice** (such as **Advantage** or **Disadvantage**), you may reroll **only one** of those dice. The rerolled die replaces its original result before determining the final outcome.
- If the repeated roll succeeds against an effect that would have inflicted **Fear**, **Charm**, or another **mental condition**, you immediately ignore that condition.
- The repeated attempt is treated as a completely new roll.
- You must accept the result of the second attempt, even if it is lower than the original.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Only the most devoted Paladins ever reach this level of conviction. Their faith has become so resolute that even despair itself struggles to take hold. Tales of these champions often describe impossible moments where curses were resisted, ancient horrors were defied, and hopeless situations turned aside through nothing more than absolute trust in their patron.

Among the faithful, it is believed that these miracles do not alter destiny. Rather, they reveal the path that destiny always intended for those whose conviction never falters. Such champions become living examples that true strength is found not in avoiding failure, but in refusing to let failure define the end of one's journey.

> *"When hope has been exhausted and strength has failed, conviction alone remains. Sometimes, that is enough to change the course of history."*  
> **— High Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your faith has become absolute. No longer bound by doubt or fear, you have earned the unwavering trust of your patron, whose divine guidance now answers your call in your darkest moments. When all hope seems lost and failure appears inevitable, your conviction burns brighter than ever, allowing you to challenge fate one final time.

To invoke Unyielding Conviction is to surrender completely to your patron's will. Whether the outcome is triumph or defeat, you accept it without hesitation, knowing that every step of your journey serves a greater purpose. Such miracles are witnessed only by the greatest champions of the faith, becoming stories that inspire generations to come.

The faithful believe that this blessing is not granted because a Paladin deserves another chance, but because their patron believes their purpose has not yet been fulfilled.

### Effects

- **Once per Long Rest**, after failing a **Saving Throw** or **Skill Check**, you may invoke **Unyielding Conviction**.
- Spend **30 MP** and **30 SP** to activate this ability.
- Repeat the failed roll using your **Luck Modifier** in place of the attribute modifier normally applied to the roll.
- Gain a **+6 bonus** to the repeated roll.
- If the original action required additional **MP, SP, HP, consumables, charges, ammunition, or other resources**, those costs must also be paid again before the second attempt is made.
- If the failed roll involved **multiple dice** (such as **Advantage** or **Disadvantage**), you may reroll **only one** of those dice. The rerolled die replaces its original result before determining the final outcome.
- If the repeated roll succeeds, you immediately end **one negative condition** currently affecting you.
- The repeated attempt is treated as a completely new roll.
- You must accept the result of the second attempt, even if it is lower than the original.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Throughout history, only a handful of Paladins have attained such absolute conviction. Their names are recorded within the holiest scriptures, remembered not for the battles they won, but for the moments when they refused to surrender despite impossible odds. Their unwavering devotion became living proof that faith is strongest when everything else has failed.

Many believe these miracles defy destiny itself. The oldest temples teach otherwise. They claim that destiny was never rewritten at all—it merely revealed the path reserved for those whose conviction could never be broken. To possess such faith is to become more than a champion; it is to become a living testament to the ideals of your patron.

> *"When every path ends, faith reveals one that mortal eyes could never see."*  
> **— High Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Prerequisites
None

See individual rank details.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

# Vigilant Protector

## Overview
A true Paladin never truly lowers their guard. Even during moments of rest, your unwavering faith allows your patron to quietly guide your senses toward approaching danger. Though your body may sleep, your spirit remains ever watchful, instinctively alert to hostile beings that threaten those under your protection.

When battle is joined, that same divine awareness allows you to react with remarkable speed. Rather than watching helplessly as an ally suffers a devastating blow, you instinctively place yourself between them and danger, trusting your faith, armour, and unwavering resolve to endure what others cannot.

To those who travel beside you, your presence offers more than protection—it offers peace of mind. They know that, while you still stand, someone is always watching over them.

## Rank 1
### Description

A true Paladin never truly lowers their guard. Even during moments of rest, your unwavering faith allows your patron to quietly guide your senses toward approaching danger. Though your body may sleep, your spirit remains ever watchful, instinctively alert to hostile beings that threaten those under your protection.

When battle is joined, that same divine awareness allows you to react with remarkable speed. Rather than watching helplessly as an ally suffers a devastating blow, you instinctively place yourself between them and danger, trusting your faith, armour, and unwavering resolve to endure what others cannot.

To those who travel beside you, your presence offers more than protection—it offers peace of mind. They know that, while you still stand, someone is always watching over them.

### Effects

#### Passive — Ever Vigilant

- Even while **resting**, **sleeping**, or otherwise not actively standing watch, you remain spiritually alert.
- You may still attempt **Perception Checks** to detect the approach of **hostile creatures or humanoids** that present an immediate threat to you or your allies.
- These Perception Checks are made with **Disadvantage**.
- **Ever Vigilant** cannot be used to detect traps, poisons, hidden objects, environmental hazards, magical effects, or any other non-creature dangers.
- Additional passive effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

#### Active — Vigilant Protector

- **Reaction**
- Spend **10 MP** and **30 SP**.
- **Cooldown:** **4 Rounds**.
- When an allied creature within **5 metres** is targeted by a melee or ranged weapon attack, you may activate **Vigilant Protector**.
- Move up to **2 metres** towards the targeted ally without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- You must end this movement adjacent to the targeted ally.
- You may choose to become the new target of the triggering attack.
- Resolve the attack against your own **AC**, armour, resistances, and defensive effects.
- If you cannot reach the targeted ally, this ability cannot be activated.

### Lore

The oldest Paladin Orders teach that vigilance is the first duty of every guardian. Long before blades are drawn or shields are raised, a watchful protector has already begun safeguarding those entrusted to their care. Through unwavering devotion, a Paladin's patron grants subtle guidance, stirring their senses whenever hostile creatures draw near, even as they rest.

Many tales speak of champions who awoke moments before an ambush or stepped between an ally and certain death with impossible speed. Whether these moments were instinct, discipline, or divine intervention is a matter of faith. To a Paladin, however, the answer is simple—their duty is to stand between darkness and those who cannot defend themselves.

> *"A guardian's greatest strength is not the shield they carry, but the vigilance to raise it before danger strikes."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your devotion has sharpened your instincts beyond those of an ordinary guardian. The quiet guidance of your patron grows clearer, allowing your senses to remain attentive even while your body rests. Though you may sleep beside your companions, your spirit remains ever watchful, instinctively searching for approaching threats before they strike.

On the battlefield, your reactions become faster and more decisive. You instinctively move to shield your allies from danger, placing yourself between them and the enemy with unwavering confidence. Every successful intervention reinforces your reputation as a steadfast protector whose first instinct is always to defend others.

### Effects

#### Passive — Ever Vigilant

- Even while **resting**, **sleeping**, or otherwise not actively standing watch, you remain spiritually alert.
- You may still attempt **Perception Checks** to detect the approach of **hostile creatures or humanoids** that present an immediate threat to you or your allies.
- These Perception Checks are made with a **−2 penalty** instead of **Disadvantage**.
- **Ever Vigilant** cannot be used to detect traps, poisons, hidden objects, environmental hazards, magical effects, or any other non-creature dangers.
- Additional passive effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

#### Active — Vigilant Protector

- **Reaction**
- Spend **10 MP** and **30 SP**.
- **Cooldown:** **3 Rounds**.
- When an allied creature within **7 metres** is targeted by a melee or ranged weapon attack, you may activate **Vigilant Protector**.
- Move up to **4 metres** towards the targeted ally without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- You must end this movement adjacent to the targeted ally.
- You may choose to become the new target of the triggering attack.
- Resolve the attack against your own **AC**, armour, resistances, and defensive effects.
- If you cannot reach the targeted ally, this ability cannot be activated.

### Lore

Those who devote their lives to protecting others soon discover that vigilance is more than remaining awake—it is a state of constant readiness. The greatest guardians learn to trust the subtle guidance of their patron, whose presence quietly warns them of approaching danger long before steel is drawn.

Veterans often recall moments where a Paladin seemed to awaken seconds before an ambush or crossed impossible distances to shield a companion from a deadly strike. Whether these feats are born from instinct or divine intervention matters little to those whose lives were saved by them.

> *"The watch never truly ends. Even in silence, a guardian listens for the footsteps of darkness."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your patron's guidance has become second nature, allowing your spirit to remain constantly aware of threats against those under your protection. Even in moments of rest, your instincts remain sharp, sensing hostile intent before weapons are drawn. Your vigilance is no longer simply a matter of discipline—it has become a divine gift.

In battle, your reactions border on the miraculous. Whether a deadly arrow, crushing blow, or hostile spell threatens an ally, you instinctively move without hesitation, placing yourself between danger and those entrusted to your care. To your companions, your intervention feels almost impossible, as though your patron guides every step you take.

### Effects

#### Passive — Ever Vigilant

- Even while **resting**, **sleeping**, or otherwise not actively standing watch, you remain spiritually alert.
- You may still attempt **Perception Checks** to detect the approach of **hostile creatures or humanoids** that present an immediate threat to you or your allies.
- These Perception Checks are made with a **−1 penalty**.
- **Ever Vigilant** cannot be used to detect traps, poisons, hidden objects, environmental hazards, magical effects, or any other non-creature dangers.
- Additional passive effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

#### Active — Vigilant Protector

- **Reaction**
- Spend **10 MP** and **30 SP**.
- **Cooldown:** **2 Rounds**.
- When an allied creature within **9 metres** is targeted by a **melee attack, ranged attack, or single-target hostile ability**, you may activate **Vigilant Protector**.
- Move up to **6 metres** towards the targeted ally without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- You must end this movement adjacent to the targeted ally.
- You may choose to become the new target of the triggering attack or ability, provided you are a valid target.
- Resolve the attack or ability against your own **AC**, armour, resistances, Saving Throws, and other defensive effects as appropriate.
- If you cannot reach the targeted ally, or if you are not a valid target for the triggering ability, this ability cannot be activated.

### Lore

The greatest protectors do not simply react to danger—they anticipate it. Through years of unwavering devotion, your patron's presence sharpens your awareness until every hostile movement, whispered incantation, and drawn weapon becomes another opportunity to safeguard those beside you.

Among the oldest Paladin Orders, it is said that a true guardian needs no command to act. Their heart moves before their feet, and their faith moves before their heart. Such champions become legends, remembered not for the enemies they defeated, but for the countless lives they preserved through selfless courage.

> *"The finest guardian is not the one who stands behind another with a shield, but the one who arrives before the blow ever lands."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron's blessing has transformed your vigilance into an instinctive act of divine guardianship. Every heartbeat is filled with purpose, every movement guided by an unwavering resolve to protect those who stand beside you. Whether danger comes from blade, arrow, or spell, you answer without hesitation, placing yourself between your allies and certain harm.

Even while your companions sleep, your spirit remains alert, ever watchful for those who would threaten the innocent. In battle, your interventions become almost supernatural, as though your patron guides every step before your conscious mind can react. To your allies, your arrival is a source of hope; to your enemies, it is the crushing realization that their target is no longer unprotected.

### Effects

#### Passive — Ever Vigilant

- Even while **resting**, **sleeping**, or otherwise not actively standing watch, you remain spiritually alert.
- You may still attempt **Perception Checks** to detect the approach of **hostile creatures or humanoids** that present an immediate threat to you or your allies.
- These Perception Checks are made **normally**.
- **Ever Vigilant** cannot be used to detect traps, poisons, hidden objects, environmental hazards, magical effects, or any other non-creature dangers.
- Additional passive effects granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

#### Active — Vigilant Protector

- **Reaction**
- Spend **10 MP** and **30 SP**.
- **Cooldown:** **2 Rounds**.
- When an allied creature within **12 metres** is targeted by a **melee attack, ranged attack, or single-target hostile ability**, you may activate **Vigilant Protector**.
- Move up to **8 metres** towards the targeted ally without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- You must end this movement adjacent to the targeted ally.
- You may choose to become the new target of the triggering attack or ability, provided you are a valid target.
- Resolve the attack or ability against your own **AC**, armour, resistances, Saving Throws, and other defensive effects as appropriate.
- After successfully intercepting the attack or ability, reduce the damage you suffer by **your Charisma Modifier** (minimum 1).
- If you cannot reach the targeted ally, or if you are not a valid target for the triggering ability, this ability cannot be activated.

### Lore

The greatest guardians are remembered not for the enemies they defeated, but for the countless lives they preserved through unwavering devotion. Their vigilance became legendary, allowing them to answer danger before others even realised it had arrived. To witness such a champion was to understand that true protection is not simply enduring harm, but willingly accepting it in another's place.

Within the oldest Paladin Orders, Rank IV is regarded as the point where a guardian ceases to fight only for victory and instead becomes a living sanctuary for those under their care. Their patron's blessing guides every step, ensuring that hope always arrives before despair can take hold.

> *"A guardian's oath is fulfilled not when they survive the battle, but when those behind them do."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your vigilance has become legendary, your patron's guidance ever-present within your heart. Whether standing upon the battlefield or resting beside your companions, your spirit remains forever watchful, instinctively sensing hostile intent before steel is drawn or spells are cast. Few champions ever attain such unwavering awareness, for it represents the highest expression of a guardian's oath.

When danger threatens those under your protection, hesitation no longer exists. Guided by faith rather than instinct alone, you move with impossible speed to intercept attacks that would otherwise claim innocent lives. Every step you take is an act of devotion, every wound endured a testament to your sacred covenant.

Those who fight beside you speak not of miracles or impossible feats, but of certainty. They know that while you still stand, they are never truly alone.

### Effects

#### Passive — Ever Vigilant

- Even while **resting**, **sleeping**, or otherwise not actively standing watch, you remain spiritually alert.
- You may make **Perception Checks** to detect the approach of **hostile creatures or humanoids** that present an immediate threat to you or your allies.
- These Perception Checks are made **with Advantage**.
- **Ever Vigilant** cannot be used to detect traps, poisons, hidden objects, environmental hazards, magical effects, or any other non-creature dangers.
- Additional passive effects granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

#### Active — Vigilant Protector

- **Reaction**
- Spend **10 MP** and **30 SP**.
- **Cooldown:** **2 Rounds**.
- When an allied creature within **15 metres** is targeted by a **melee attack, ranged attack, or single-target hostile ability**, you may activate **Vigilant Protector**.
- Move up to **your Movement Speed** towards the targeted ally without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- You must end this movement adjacent to the targeted ally.
- You may choose to become the new target of the triggering attack or ability, provided you are a valid target.
- Resolve the attack or ability against your own **AC**, armour, resistances, Saving Throws, and other defensive effects as appropriate.
- Reduce the damage you suffer from the intercepted attack or ability by **twice your Charisma Modifier** (minimum 2).
- If you cannot reach the targeted ally, or if you are not a valid target for the triggering ability, this ability cannot be activated.

### Lore

The greatest Paladins are remembered not for the foes they defeated, but for the countless lives they preserved. Their vigilance became the stuff of legend, allowing them to answer danger before others even realised it existed. Kings entrusted them with royal heirs, armies marched with renewed confidence beneath their banners, and ordinary people slept peacefully knowing such guardians stood watch.

Among the oldest temples, reaching this mastery is considered the final proof of a Paladin's covenant. Their patron no longer grants fleeting moments of guidance—their vigilance becomes a permanent blessing. Wherever such a champion walks, hope follows, for every soul knows that no darkness reaches them without first facing the guardian who refuses to yield.

> *"The greatest protector is not remembered for the battles they won, but for the lives that continued because they stood in the way."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**
